Using the app and its content.
Follow VALORANT in your language, with clearer logos and a more reliable connection at startup.
The app now follows your device language, with support for English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Korean.
Team and event logos keep their original colors, including in rankings. Backgrounds adjust for contrast so logos stay easy to see in light and dark themes.
Connection checks at startup are more reliable, helping the app recognize when you are online.

A thank-you from Shreyansh and Akhil.
It started with friends in different cities and a few games of VALORANT. More than five years later, the game is still a big part of our lives.
Somewhere between matches, we decided to put the skills from our day jobs into building an app for a game we love and follow.
If Val Esports has helped you follow the game, an honest review helps other fans find it too.
Thanks for trying out Val Esports. Your feedback helps us make it better.
Have an idea, spotted a bug, or just want to say hello? We'd love to hear from you.
